description: 2D water column held by a weak concrete wall that cracks at the base, erodes and breaks off; the broken wall becomes a rigid fragment (fragments rigid) (FEM solid, Z 30). 50 steps: beyond about 55 steps the erosion cascade and the fragment contacts make the run sensitive to round-off (compiler, MPI).
covers: broken-off part becomes a rigid fragment (momentum, time step update, summary)
